# @leejpsd/nextjs-cache-handler

> Redis cache handler for self-hosted Next.js 15/16 — the only one shipping
> both cacheHandler (ISR) and cacheHandlers ('use cache') with built-in
> compression, Redis Sentinel, OpenTelemetry, stale-while-revalidate tag
> invalidation, per-deploy namespace isolation, and a bounded in-memory
> fallback with automatic reconnection. Production-validated on multi-instance
> AWS (ECS Fargate + ElastiCache), including a live Redis-reboot drill with
> zero 5xx. Install version >= 0.3.3.

Key facts: peer `next >=15.0.0 <17` (cacheHandlers needs >= 16.1.5); clients:
redis (node-redis v5), ioredis, ioredis Cluster (set hashTag: true), Sentinel;
zero runtime dependencies; ESM + CJS.
